for L_,h in [(2,0),(6,11),(10,10)]:
    p=f'bert.encoder.layer.{L_}.attention.'
    v=base(p+'self.value.weight'); o=base(p+'output.dense.weight')
    sl=slice(h*64,(h+1)*64)
    print(L_, 'V rows norm', np.linalg.norm(v[sl][:8],axis=1), 'V absmax', np.abs(v[sl][:8]).max())
    print('  O sub', np.round(o[np.ix_(res, range(h*64,h*64+8))],3).diagonal(), np.abs(o[np.ix_(res, range(h*64,h*64+8))]).max())
    print('  V reserved cols', np.abs(v[sl][:8][:,res]).max())
# overall hidden scale hints: LN weights of layer 1 output, embeddings LN
print(np.abs(base('bert.embeddings.LayerNorm.weight')).mean(), base('bert.embeddings.LayerNorm.weight')[res])
